caption: The image depicts a drawing of a ceramic jug with two handles attached near the narrow neck. The jug is tan or light brown in color and is decorated with dark blue ornamental designs on its front surface. The central motif is a large fern-like plant with multiple leaflets extending upward and outward. Around the fern, there are additional decorative elements, including abstract floral or botanical shapes, such as a crescent-like curve surrounded by dots, a circular dotted form, and other lobed and spiked designs. The handle attachments and the base appear plain, with all decoration concentrated on the main body of the jug. The background is a plain, off-white color, highlighting the jug's form and painted details.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
